import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long multiplyPower(int p, long exponent) {
        long res = 1;
        for (long cnt = 0; cnt < exponent; ++cnt) {
            res = (res * p) % MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();

        long num;
        if (k <= 1) {
            num = multiplyPower(p, (long) p - 1 + k);
        } else {
            num = 1;
            boolean[] used = new boolean[p];
            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                if (used[i]) continue;
                num = (num * p) % MOD;
                int q = i;
                do {
                    used[q] = true;
                    q = (int) ((long) q * k % p);
                } while (q != i);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(num);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
